<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, only one carbon signal (19.23 ppm) falls within the typical range for a simple alkyl methyl carbon (≈10–30 ppm). The other upfield signals (≈43–52 ppm) correspond to carbons attached to heteroatoms or carbonyls, which are not standard methyl signals. Therefore, the molecule contains a single CH₃ group.</thought>
